name: Intro Mission
briefing: Scorched Oasis: a pool of cool water ringed by scrub and scattered woods, with dry hardpan all around. Eris Lance comes in from the south edge and Solitaire Lance from the north, and both want the shade and the high ground. Cut the water or the trees between you and the guns you cannot afford to face. Put every working enemy 'Mech down, or leave them too crippled to fight, and the oasis is yours.
